exposure: Concomitant treatment with corticosteroids during pregnancy
Systemic steroid administration during the third trimester
outcome: Risk of serious infections in offspring
Infant infections resulting in hospital admission
cohort: The study included all singleton IBD pregnancies between 2008 and 2022 at a tertiary IBD center in Denmark.
finding: Preterm birth and systemic corticosteroid administration during the third trimester were significantly associated with an increased risk of serious infections in the offspring immediately after birth.
